title: The draft-PR guard reads a PowerShell here-string piped to pwsh or iex
why: A PowerShell expandable here-string (`@"`...`"@`) piped to pwsh or iex is not read by the draft-PR guard (decision draft-until-reviewed). Main has the same gap, and Claude writes these on the owner's Windows machine.
note: Lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm takes it after #1642, stacked. Filed at the coordinator's request, 18:45 CST Nov 7. Started 21:39 CST Nov 7 in lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm, stacked on #1713 (lane message).
